clips.title: The story
paras: Fel Rock is a blighted cavern hidden within the woods just north of Dolanaar on the boughs of Teldrassil. Once a tranquil hollow, it has fallen into corruption under the influence of the satyr Lord Melenas and his horde of vicious grells.

Tucked away in the forested hills north of Dolanaar, Fel Rock was once an ordinary, peaceful cavern carved into the wood and stone of Teldrassil. Today, it stands as an unsettling reminder of the creeping taint encroaching on the world tree. Twisted roots and unnatural shadows dominate the cavern interior, overrun by swarms of wild grells and grellkin.

The corruption within Fel Rock stems from the presence of Lord Melenas, a wicked satyr who has claimed the hollow as a stronghold. From deep within the cave, he orchestrates the spread of malevolent corruption right under the watchful gaze of the night elf sentinels. Druids from Dolanaar, particularly Tallonkai Swiftroot, actively enlist capable defenders to cleanse the cave and slay Melenas before his foul blight can spread further into the surrounding woodlands.
